summary.en: The Sudanese army has taken Bakori and Sali and repelled attacks in the Blue Nile while advancing in West Kordofan, where it reports further gains. It has arrested a former Bashir-era official and former ruling party head Ahmed Haroun, who was detained after a podcast appearance. Ethiopian fighters are being recruited into the Sudanese army and Tigrayan fighters have been drawn into the conflict, expanding the pool of combatants. The war caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren har tatt Bakori og Sali og avverget angrep i Blue Nile mens den avanserer i Vest-Kordofan, hvor den rapporterer ytterligere fremrykkinger. Den har arrestert en tidligere Bashir-tids offiser og tidligere leder for det regjerende partiet Ahmed Haroun, som ble pågrepet etter et podkastopptreden. Etiopiske soldater blir rekruttert inn i den sudanske hæren og tigrayanske krigere har blitt trukket inn i konflikten, noe som utvider rekruttbasen. Krigen forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
